programme.title: Ngwana Wa Tshwenya
programme.desc: 'S2/E8 - Chantel'. Chantel from Protea Soweto fights with everyone and even assaults her mother. After being expelled from school, Mme Morake calls Israel for an urgent intervention.

programme.title: Tseleng
programme.desc: 'S3/E9 - Nomalanga & Matshepo'. Nomalanga, a Zimbabwean woman, believes she is testing Nthabiseng's strength.

programme.title: Sugar Mamas Jhb
programme.desc: 'S3/E4 - Health Issues'. Age is just a number for these sugar mamas and their Ben10's. Discover unconventional love stories between older women and younger men.

programme.title: Councillor Tsotsi
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. A gritty investigative series following a councillor exposing corruption and injustice while amplifying community voices in the fight for truth and accountability.

programme.title: Fake Gobela
programme.desc: 'S4/E9 - Sarah'. Sarah Claims her Gobela owes her money as she did not complete her Initiation. She claims she was abused as well. The tables turned and it was a confusing sight.

programme.title: X-Repo
programme.desc: 'S7/E8'. Step inside the fast paced world where the X-Repo team helps people reclaim what is rightfully theirs from cars and trucks to furniture and more.

programme.title: Vimba
programme.desc: 'S2/E11'. A crime investigation television show that aims to clean up our streets by tackling various crime syndicates and criminal activists.

programme.title: Sizok'thola
programme.desc: 'S5/E11 - Fake businesses'. In a surprise drug raid the team finds businesses that are seemingly innocent whilst in reality they are drug dens fronting as small businesses.

programme.title: You Promised To Marry Me
programme.desc: 'S4/E7 - Noxolo'. Everyone needs to know where they stand in a relationship. You Promised To Marry Me, is about the people who feel betrayed by their partners to honour or fulfil their promise of marrying them.

programme.title: Uyaphuza
programme.desc: 'S6/E1'. An intervention to help relieve loved ones of the social ills associated with alcohol abuse.

programme.title: Ishushu
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Xoliswa And Busi'. Xoliswa and Busi always cook side by side for their catering business but Xoliswa wants Busi to know she is the better cook.

programme.title: Lala Ngoxolo
programme.desc: 'S3/E1 - Lethabo Ratsuoma'. A reality show hosted by a medium that can communicate with the departed. The show provides an opportunity for the family to communicate with their deceased loved ones.

programme.title: Hope
programme.desc: 'S1/E48'. Pastor Zakes runs a struggling church in downtown Johannesburg. Plagued by financial problems, a rival church down the road stealing his members.

programme.title: Colours

programme.title: The Naked Gun
programme.desc: Liam Neeson takes on a slapstick comedy role in this reboot of the 1980s classic. After following in his father's footsteps, Frank Drebin Jr must prevent the closure of Police Squad.

programme.title: M3gan
programme.desc: Chucky fans, stand up! A robotics engineer at a toy company builds a life-like doll that begins to take on a life of its own in this eye-opening sci-fi horror.

programme.title: Cut Throat City
programme.desc: A compelling crime drama set in the aftermath of the destructive Hurricane Katrina. Four friends, desperate to make ends meet, become involved with a local gang and a dangerous heist.

programme.title: After Everything
programme.desc: The fifth and final chapter of the After franchise. Hardin travels to Portugal in search of a woman he wronged in the past - and in hopes of finding himself.

programme.title: The Plus One
programme.desc: Music superstar Ashanti leads this romcom. Lizzie is looking to have the perfect destination wedding, but plans are thrown into disarray when her 'Male of Honour' brings his ex.

programme.title: Zero To Zero
programme.desc: A moving South African film about Covid-19. Filmed over a year, this unequalled footage from ICU and beyond tells a story of despair, hope and the strength of the human spirit.

programme.title: Kingdoms Of Fire, Ice & Fairytales
programme.desc: Get up close and personal with the ice-covered landmass of Antarctica, the magical Black Forest of Germany, and the iconic Yellowstone of the USA, get up close and personal to these three world wonders.

programme.title: Midway
programme.desc: Woody Harrelson, Patrick Wilson and Luke Evans star in this real-event-based WWII drama about the Battle of Midway, which was a clash between US and Japanese militaries.

programme.title: Flight 149: Hostage Of War
programme.desc: When Flight 149 landed in Kuwait, its passengers became pawns in Saddam's invasion, held as human shields. Decades later, survivors seek justice and the truth.

programme.title: Golda
programme.desc: Helen Mirren drives this tense and absorbing biopic that focuses on the high-stakes decisions that Golda Meir, known as the 'Iron Lady of Israel,' faced during the Yom Kippur War.

programme.title: Twisted Christmas
programme.desc: Themes of reconciliation and family unity drive this local Christmas comedy. A wealthy family spends Christmas with their Muslim landscaper and his family.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out Of...
programme.desc: The Spongebob Movie: Sponge Out Of Water. A great SpongeBob film. SpongeBob and his enemy team up to retrieve the stolen, Krabby Patty formula.

programme.title: Richard The Stork 2
programme.desc: Richard, the daring sparrow who was adopted by a stork family, is back for another adventure. He embarks on a solo journey when he realises he won't be his flock's leader.

programme.title: Bean
programme.desc: Britain's beloved Mr Bean gets his first movie. More hilarious and bumbling antics ensue when Bean is dispatched to LA to deliver an extremely valuable painting.

programme.title: Infinite
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg and Chiwetel Ejiofor drive this book-inspired sci-fi action adaptation about a man who learns he's been reincarnated many times and holds the key to saving the world.

programme.title: Kick-Ass 2
programme.desc: It's bigger and fiercer in this action-filled sequel. This time, Kick-Ass teams up with other courageous wannabe heroes to stop the Red Mist from exacting his revenge.

programme.title: Saw X
programme.desc: The tenth film in the horror franchise, with Tobin Bell returning. Set between the events of SAW I and II, John Kramer plots his twisted revenge on the doctors who conned him.

programme.title: Boy Kills World
programme.desc: A funny, bloody and over-the-top revenge film. Boy is a maniacal killer who's been trained to assassinate Hilda Van Der Koy and avenge his family's murder.

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Melissa McCarthy gives a savage act in this riotous comedy. A titan of the industry goes to prison for insider trading. On her release, she tries to mend the bridges she burnt.

programme.title: Girl You Know It's True
programme.desc: This is a fascinating music biopic about the music duo Milli Vanilli, who rose to fame in the late '80s and early '90s only to come crashing down after their secret is exposed.

programme.title: One Life
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins leads this true story of bravery. A London broker helps save hundreds of predominantly Jewish children from the Nazis just before the start of WWII.

programme.title: Dog
programme.desc: Channing Tatum drives this heartfelt drama. A former Army Ranger and a military dog are paired against their will on the road trip to a fellow soldier's funeral.

programme.title: The Miracle Club
programme.desc: A brilliant female cast drives this heartwarming 1967-set film. A group of Catholic women win tickets to visit the sacred French town of Lourdes in the hope of a miracle.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: Get ready for some good, wholesome fun in this animated joyride. A rookie race car driver gets the opportunity to rally along the famous Silk Road trade route.

programme.title: How To Save The Immortal
programme.desc: An epic animated adventure about Russia's fairytale villain. Forced to kidnap a girl, hardened bachelor Koschey embarks on an adventure that makes him a hero he never expected.

programme.title: Paws Of Fury: The Legend Of Hank
programme.desc: A starry voice cast drives this animated film. A down-on-his-luck dog finds himself in a town full of cats who need a hero to help save their village from a ruthless villain.

programme.title: Mr. Bean's Holiday
programme.desc: The BAFTA-winning Rowan Atkinson reprises his role as the legendary Mr Bean. This time around, chaos follows him on holiday to France.

programme.title: Snake Eyes: G.I. Joe Origins
programme.desc: Henry Golding and Andrew Koji drive this action-packed G.I. Joe spin-off. A tenacious loner is welcomed into an ancient Japanese clan, but his honour and loyalty are tested.

programme.title: The Tuxedo
programme.desc: Jackie Chan turns on the charm in this action film. A chauffeur is thrust into the world of international espionage when he puts on a suit that gives him extraordinary powers.

programme.title: Cuckoo
programme.desc: An eerie and unsettling horror thriller. After a 17-year-old girl moves to live with her father at a cabin resort, she soon discovers something isn't right.
